About Us Our mission at Avelios is to unlock clinical data to power seamless healthcare operations for better patient care. To do so, we have built a modular software platform that digitizes and optimizes workflows in hospitals with cutting-edge technology in a user-friendly way. With our software, we enable hospitals, doctors & nurses to provide their patients with the best possible care. We are growing fast and want to keep expanding our team and business to fundamentally digitize healthcare for the better. We appreciate different backgrounds and see diversity as one of our strengths. THE TEAM AND YOUR ROLE As a Manual Software Tester in Healthcare (all genders) , you ensure that our software not only works reliably but also delivers an excellent user experience in the healthcare environment. Whether you bring experience in software testing and quality assurance or a clinical background with a strong interest in technology and software, you contribute your perspective to continuously improving the quality of our platform. In close collaboration with our Product and Engineering teams, you identify issues early, improve usability, and help ensure the stability and quality of our software, contributing directly to a better digital care experience in hospitals. YOUR TASKS Test software quality: Manually test our software for functionality, design, usability, and content accuracy based on defined requirements and test plans. Identify and document issues: Detect, reproduce, and precisely document all types of deviations, from spelling mistakes and usability inconsistencies to technical bugs. Manage bug reporting: Create clear and reproducible Jira tickets for identified issues and track their progress through resolution. Maintain test documentation: Develop and maintain structured test plans, test cases, and test reports to ensure consistent and traceable testing. Verify fixes: Conduct regression tests for resolved issues to confirm fixes and ensure that existing functionality remains stable. Contribute your perspective: Apply your QA experience or clinical understanding to identify opportunities to continuously improve the quality and usability of our software. Your Qualifications Either experience in software testing, test methods, and quality assurance or professional experience in a clinical environment, such as nursing, medicine, or another healthcare profession with a strong interest in software and technology Technical understanding, perseverance, and a strong commitment to quality Highly structured and self-driven working style Strong attention to detail and passion for precise results Solution-oriented mindset and hands-on mentality Experience with Jira is a plus Fluent in German and English Your Benefits Variety in your tasks and the opportunity to take ownership An international, informal team structure in a motivating start-up atmosphere, allowing you to participate directly in our customer growth story and the overall success of Avelios Ability to gain valuable hands-on experience in a startup backed by leading international VCs Support for your personal development through continuous learning and feedback Set your own rhythm with flexible working hours and trust-based time tracking A virtual stock option package (VSOP) that lets you participate in Avelios’ long-term value creation A monthly meal allowance up to 75 euros, full coverage of the Deutschlandticket, Urban Sports Club or a subsidized Wellpass membership, a bike leasing program and Corporate Benefits that give you access to discounts from a wide range of providers in various areas Show more Show less Karrierestufe Berufseinstieg Beschäftigungsverhältnis Vollzeit Tätigkeitsbereich Ingenieurwesen und IT Branchen Softwareentwicklung Mit einer Empfehlung lassen sich Ihre Chancen auf ein Vorstellungsgespräch bei Avelios Medical verdoppeln.
